messages.content: Post for the v1.15 notes. I will write the breaking changes first, then the migration steps.
Breaking change: the migration image tag must match the app image tag. A mismatch is a hard failure now.
Migration step: run the upgrade job before the rollout, never after, or the old pods read the new schema.
Notes draft is in the release branch. I kept every command from the incident so the reader can copy it.
Decision: publish the notes with the verification checklist as its own section, because that is what people skip.
Verification before publish: the checklist names a command for every step, and no step depends on a private dashboard.
